title: Shapes and Angles
description: Understand polygons, classify angles, and apply perimeter and area with visual self-check tasks.

lessons.title: Classifying Basic Shapes
objectives: Identify common polygons by number of sides

pedagogy.title: Count carefully
pedagogy.content: When classifying a polygon, count sides and corners first, then check if sides are equal.

pedagogy.title: Use elimination
pedagogy.content: If a shape has 4 sides, it cannot be a triangle or pentagon. Narrow options quickly.

content.content: A polygon is a closed shape made of straight line segments. Triangles have 3 sides, quadrilaterals have 4, pentagons have 5, and hexagons have 6.
A square is a quadrilateral because it has 4 sides, and all sides are equal.

content.prompt: Sketch one triangle, one quadrilateral, and one pentagon. Label each shape.

exercises.question: Which shape has exactly 5 sides?
hints: Recall the names by side count: 3 triangle, 4 quadrilateral, 5 pentagon.
Eliminate options with 3 or 4 sides first.

exercises.question: Draw a rectangle and a square. Under each, write one property that makes it different from the other.
hints: Both are quadrilaterals with 4 right angles.
A square has all sides equal; a rectangle has opposite sides equal.
exercises.solution: Self-check: rectangle and square are both 4-sided with right angles. A square has 4 equal sides; a rectangle has equal opposite sides.

lessons.title: Angles, Perimeter, and Area
objectives: Classify acute, right, and obtuse angles
Compute perimeter and area of rectangles

pedagogy.title: Angle quick check
pedagogy.content: Acute is small (<90), right is exact (90), obtuse is wide (>90 and <180).

pedagogy.title: Perimeter vs area
pedagogy.content: Perimeter adds side lengths around the outside; area measures inside space.

content.content: Angles describe turns between two rays. Perimeter measures boundary length, while area measures surface inside a shape.
If a rectangle has length 8 and width 3, then perimeter is 2(8+3)=22 and area is 8×3=24.

exercises.question: An angle measures 120°. What type is it?
hints: It is more than a right angle but less than a straight angle.
exercises.solution: 120° is obtuse because it is greater than 90° and less than 180°.

exercises.question: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 12 and width 5.
hints: Substitute l=12 and w=5, then multiply by 2.

exercises.question: A classroom floor is a rectangle 9 m by 7 m. Write your area calculation and final answer with units.
hints: Include square units in your final answer.
exercises.solution: Self-check: A = 9 × 7 = 63 m^2. Your response should show multiplication and include m^2.
